title.zh: Sui 基金会向 DATA Network 投资 3000 万美元，该 AI 数据协议将迁移至 Sui
title.en: Sui Foundation invests $30 million in DATA Network as AI data protocol migrates to Sui

current_state.zh: Sui 基金会向 DATA Network 投资 3000 万美元，DATA Network 将升级为在 Sui 上原生运行的协议，其独立链将退役，DATA 代币按 1:1 迁移至 Sui，Walrus 将成为默认存储层，过渡完成前原网络继续运营。
current_state.en: Sui Foundation is investing $30 million into DATA Network, which will upgrade to run natively on Sui, retire its standalone chain, swap DATA tokens 1:1 to Sui, integrate with Walrus as default storage layer, and continue operating until transition completion.

updates.title_zh: Sui基金会向DATA Network投资3000万美元，AI训练数据协议将迁移至Sui
updates.title_en: Sui基金会向DATA Network投资3000万美元，AI训练数据协议将迁移至Sui
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：DATA Network 独立链将退役，现有 DATA 代币按 1:1 迁移至 Sui，Walrus 将成为 DATA Foundation 运营应用的默认存储层；Sui 基金会将成为 DATA Network 最大机构持有者，与 PIP Labs 和 DATA Foundation 并列；过渡完成前原网络继续运营，基金会将在升级前发布详细时间表。
updates.what_changed_en: New report adds: DATA Network's standalone chain will be retired; existing DATA tokens will migrate 1:1 to Sui; Walrus will become the default storage layer for DATA Foundation-operated apps; Sui Foundation will become DATA Network's largest institutional holder alongside PIP Labs and DATA Foundation; the original network continues operating until transition completion, and the foundation will publish a detailed timeline before the upgrade.
updates.current_state_zh: Sui 基金会向 DATA Network 投资 3000 万美元，DATA Network 将升级为在 Sui 上原生运行的协议，其独立链将退役，DATA 代币按 1:1 迁移至 Sui，Walrus 将成为默认存储层，过渡完成前原网络继续运营。
updates.current_state_en: Sui Foundation is investing $30 million into DATA Network, which will upgrade to run natively on Sui, retire its standalone chain, swap DATA tokens 1:1 to Sui, integrate with Walrus as default storage layer, and continue operating until transition completion.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Sui Foundation is investing $30 million into AI training-data protocol DATA Network, which will migrate natively to Sui with its standalone chain retired, its DATA token swapped 1:1, and Walrus serving as the default storage layer for DATA Foundation apps.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Sui Foundation is investing $30 million into AI training-data protocol DATA Network, which will migrate natively to Sui with its standalone chain retired, its DATA token swapped 1:1, and Walrus serving as the default storage layer for DATA Foundation apps.
updates.background_zh: Story Protocol 在转向 AI 训练的调整中更名为 Data Network，其 Story Protocol 代币（IP）变为 Data Network 代币（DATA），代币按 1:1 比例迁移，IP 持有者无需进行任何操作。Sui 是由 Mysten Labs 开发的 Layer 1 区块链，该公司于 2021 年 9 月由 Meta Diem 项目的前工程师创立，Sui 围绕以对象为中心的数据模型和 Move 编程语言的一个变体构建。
updates.background_en: Story Protocol rebranded as Data Network in an AI-training pivot, and its Story Protocol token (IP) became the Data Network token (DATA), with tokens migrating at a 1:1 ratio and no action required from IP holders. Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain developed by Mysten Labs, the company founded in September 2021 by former engineers from Meta's Diem project, built around an object-centric data model and a variant of the Move programming language.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件将 DATA 的质押与智能合约活动从旧链转移至 Sui，因此该代币的流动性、托管与验证者敞口正通过 Sui 生态重新配置。在 1:1 迁移窗口期内，旧链上的 DATA 持有者是受影响最直接的群体。
updates.market_impact_en: The event shifts DATA's staking and smart-contract activity off the legacy chain and onto Sui, so the token's liquidity, custody and validator exposure are being redirected through the Sui ecosystem. Holders of DATA on the retiring chain are the most directly affected segment during the one-for-one migration window.
